_note: TOEIC Part 6–7 kiểu (Claude soạn 28/10/2026, chưa người thật kiểm; tên người, công ty đều bịa; không chép đề ETS). p6: văn bản có {1}…{4}, mỗi chỗ 4 phương án (một chỗ là chèn câu). p7: một văn bản (one) hoặc 2–3 văn bản (multi), câu hỏi trắc nghiệm.

docs.title: Local firm goes green
docs.text: PORTVILLE — Lindqvist Printing, one of Portville's oldest businesses, has completed the installation of 600 solar panels on the roof of its factory. The panels are expected to provide about 40 percent of the company's electricity. "Our customers increasingly ask about the environmental impact of their orders," said owner Erik Lindqvist. "This investment helps us answer that question and lowers our costs over time." The company also plans to switch to recycled paper for all standard orders by next spring. Lindqvist Printing was founded in 1962 by Mr. Lindqvist's grandfather and now employs 85 people.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
w: The history of printing in Portville
A new product launched by a printer
The opening of a solar panel factory
qs.why: Lắp pin mặt trời, chuyển sang giấy tái chế.

qs.q: According to Mr. Lindqvist, why did the company make the investment?
qs.why: Our customers increasingly ask about the environmental impact…

qs.q: What is indicated about Lindqvist Printing?
w: It only uses recycled paper now.
qs.why: founded in 1962 by Mr. Lindqvist's grandfather.

docs.title: Review of Casa Verde Restaurant ★★★★☆
docs.text: I took my parents to Casa Verde for my father's birthday last Saturday. The food was excellent, especially the grilled fish, and the portions were generous. I would definitely return, but I would book an earlier table. — Paula Grant

qs.why: not seated until almost 7:40 despite a 7:00 reservation.
